Name: Manish Gupta
Bio: Manish Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Manish Gupta is the Co-founder and CEO of Indegene. He has an enviable track record of spearheading the spectacular growth of Indegene from an initial Indian startup to a globally respected technology-led healthcare solutions organization. He is acknowledged as a pioneer and thought leader in the global life sciences digital transformation space. He is a BTech graduate from IIT-BHU, India, and holds a Master's degree in Business Administration from IIM Ahmedabad (1998), India. He is the recipient of the Young Alumni Award for Entrepreneurship from IIM Ahmedabad, India, and the Distinguished Alumnus Award from IIT-BHU, India.
Education: MBA, IIM Ahmedabad | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Varanasi
